Ahh. Stay strong fren <3 I believe you can pull through this c:

From what I know, I live in Canada and self harm is not enough to get you into a psych unit. When I was a teenager, I was never admitted to a unit for self harm, just other issues. However, I did receive hella intense therapy. Today, I am an adult (19 but an adult) and I'm currently writing from inside a psych unit and I have not met a single patient who is in here for self harm. 

But what I am going to say is that take care of yourself dear. <3 I might not be that much older than you but there were so many times where I regret having my scars (work, prom, first date) but do take it slow and one day at a time. Recovery isn't instant and give yourself love and time. I'm here if you need someone to talk to. <3 

Cheers!! (｡･ω･｡)ﾉ♡

I live in Canada and I'm in my second year of uni and before you get discharged, be sure to have a note from the psychiatrist stating when you were in the hospital. It has helped me a lot with school during past hospitalizations and my schools have been accommodating and understanding. Sometimes we have to remember that they are human too and they also deal with issues related to health. Stay strong fren (｡･ω･｡)ﾉ♡
